source: WebMCP Draft Community Group Report, 8 October 2026 (https://webmachinelearning.github.io/webmcp/): ToolAnnotations has exactly readOnlyHint, untrustedContentHint, consequentialHint and debugging.
description: WebMCP annotations are derived from catalog fields, never authored. Rule forms: copy:<field> and not-equal:<field>:<value>, where field is annotations.readOnlyHint, confirmation, returnsUntrustedContent, contentEgress or group.diagnostic. The Go validator and the mcp/webmcp generator interpret the same rules.

notes.exposed: Not a WebMCP annotation: whether the tool is registered in the browser at all. Destructive tools are never registered through WebMCP (webmcp-tool-package).
notes.dropped: destructiveHint, idempotentHint and openWorldHint are not defined by the WebMCP draft and are not emitted.
